'''Town''' is an area located to the right of the [[Crossroads]].

'''Town''' has various Blueprint Stations (labeled [[House Repair]], [[Market Stalls]], and [[Artisans|Workshop Courtyards]]) spread throughout that when built help the player continue throughout the game.
